regions.name: The Ashford Vale (Caldrenn)
regions.description: The home region of the Caldrenn Kingdom. Rolling pastoral hills, snowmelt rivers, ancient runestone wards, and fertile farmsteads.

places.name: Ashford Village
places.desc: Home village: timber-and-thatch cottages surrounding the ancient Runestone circle, mill, inn, smithy, and adventurer guild.

places.name: Kingsreach Royal Capital
places.desc: The royal castle-city of Caldrenn. High limestone bluffs, royal palaces, grand paved boulevards, and the Royal Ember Academy.

places.name: Emberglass Mere
places.desc: Deep glacial lake south-west of Ashford. At dusk the water reflects like burning embers. Fishers keep an eastern jetty.

places.name: Ashrun Stone Bridge
places.desc: Heavy stone arch bridge spanning the cold snowmelt Ashrun River on the Oakvale highway.

places.name: Duskbriar Wood
places.desc: Ancient canopy of black oak, spruce, and briar. Home to timber wolves and goblin scout parties.

places.name: Tuskridge Hold
places.desc: Ring of timber longhouses on a fortified hilltop. Exiled Tuskridge Clan led by Chief Harrok Ashmaw.

places.name: Mossfang Warren
places.desc: Subterranean burrows under tangled roots on Duskbriar's northern edge. Goblin ambush outpost.

places.name: Shrine of the Sleeping Flame
places.desc: Ancient ruined temple with cracked marble brazier. Relighting it awakens the slumbering fire soulbeast.

places.name: Cinderpost Waystation
places.desc: Bustling merchant waystation on the King's Road. Heavy wagons, stables, guard post, and notice board.

places.name: Millbrook Valley Farm
places.desc: Active agricultural estate with rotating windmill, granary, timber barn, and golden wheat fields.

places.name: Deep Iron Crag Mine
places.desc: High-altitude iron mine excavated into limestone cliff face with rail tracks, winches, and ore carts.

regions.name: Aegis-Roman Marble Empire (Aethelgard)
regions.description: Gleaming white marble metropolis: colosseums, arched aqueducts, sun gods, legionary cohorts, and coastal trading galleys.

places.name: Grand Colosseum of Aethelgard
places.desc: Colossal tiered marble arena where champion gladiators and beastmasters duel before the Emperor.

places.name: Great Aqueduct of Sol
places.desc: Spectacular 4km multi-tiered stone aqueduct carrying fresh snowmelt from the mountain peaks into public baths.

regions.name: Kemetic Sun Delta Empire (Osoris)
regions.description: Ancient golden desert delta with towering sandstone ziggurats, carved obelisks, date palm oases, and sacred river barges.

places.name: Great Ziggurat of the Dawnflame
places.desc: Massive stepped pyramid crowned by the eternal white Dawnflame fire, watched by hawk-headed high priests.

places.name: Sun Gate Palm Oasis
places.desc: Lush emerald oasis fed by underground thermal springs amidst shifting crimson dunes.

regions.name: Mount Taiyun Cultivation Peaks (Shenlu)
regions.description: Towering mist-shrouded karst mountain needles connected by iron chain bridges, lacquer pavilions, and flying sword arenas.

places.name: Heavenly Mist Sword Sect
places.desc: Legendary cultivation sect perched on the highest mountain needle above the cloud ocean. Students practice chantless sword qi.

places.name: Dragon's Breath Cloud Waterfall
places.desc: A 500-meter sheer cataract falling through perpetual rainbows into the Bamboo Sea.

regions.name: Cherry Blossom Shinto Citadel (Seirune)
regions.description: Feudal coastal citadel with dark timber tenshu keeps, cascading pink cherry blossoms, vermilion torii water gates, and dojos.

places.name: White Heron Tenshu Citadel
places.desc: Impenetrable feudal stone fortress guarded by elite Stormstitch blademasters. Overlooks the tranquil Sakura bay.

regions.name: Aetheria Celestial Sky Islands
regions.description: Massive floating landmasses hovering 1,200m above the sea, bound by titan chains, propelled by glowing cyan aether crystals.

places.name: Aether Spire & Skyship Galleon Dock
places.desc: Mooring harbor for wing-sailed sky galleons. Crystal conduits pulse with raw arcane levitation energy.

regions.name: Gundarak Subterranean Dwarven Caverns
regions.description: 10km-wide vaulted underworld city hollowed out of black granite, heated by flowing magma canals and powered by geothermal steam engines.

places.name: The Great Magma Forge & Hall of Ancestors
places.desc: The heart of Dwarven civilization. 80-meter carved stone dwarf kings flank a glowing molten bronze crucible.
